title: Verify: Mounted admin round routes return exact statuses with the admin token unit tests
summary: Add exact-status mount test to server_test.go
description: Add a test that builds New with a temp repo and checks exact statuses through the real router with Bearer tok.
acceptance_criteria: Given the on-disk round, when GET round has Bearer tok, then 200 and id ROUND-0000001
Given an unknown round id, then 404 from the handler
Given invalid JSON on POST /rounds, then 400
technical_constraints: httptest recorder only; temp dir via t.TempDir; no real Git calls (do not call open or close)
definition_of_done: Test passes with go test -run filter

steps.action: Build the same temp repo and cfg as TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted (world.yaml, round-0000001/round.yaml via writeTestFile, Admin.Token tok), call New, and table-test: GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001?world=the-boys-room expects 200 and JSON id ROUND-0000001; GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-9999999?world=the-boys-room expects 404; POST /api/v1/admin/rounds with body {bad expects 400; all with header Authorization Bearer tok.
